PAGE TITLE: OTHER INFORMATION / AGENCY RESPONSE TO OIG REPORT ON NASA'S TOP MANAGEMENT AND PERFORMANCE CHALLENGES

KEY FACTS:
- NASA has infused its Employee Value Proposition (EVP) into Agency recruitment and outreach efforts for the last five years.
- NASA's digital presence reaches over 6 million followers on LinkedIn and other social media sites.
- NASA's Office of STEM Engagement engages more than 2,000 students annually in hands-on internships.
- The Agency Master Plan (AMP) will establish a 20-year vision for physical infrastructure and real property assets.
